name: omnisearch/typesense
description: Omnisearch Typesense: omnisearch's driver for Typesense, over glitchr/typesense-bundle - the indexes declared by omnisearch's attributes become the bundle's collections (sub-collections of a discriminator included), objects its documents, omnisearch's requests its queries (infix, matched tokens, facets...), its responses omnisearch's; in a Symfony application the bundle hosts them.

suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: In a Symfony application: glitchr/typesense-bundle hosts the indexes (Bridge\Symfony\TypesenseHost)
